tuition_total.note: Homepage: 'Full-Time MBA Programme ... Duration and Tuition: 12/16 months, HK$620,000.' Same HK$620,000 for the 2-year/normative period listed by the CUHK Graduate School (https://www.gs.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/business-administration/mba, seen in search excerpt only). employment.employed_in_asia_note: Homepage: '93% graduates are employed in Asia (Full-time Student)', no cohort stated. An older banner on the same page says '98% Employed in Asia (2019 Full-Time Graduates)'.

base_salary.note: No current employment report found. The former 2019 and 2020 employment report PDFs on mba.cuhk.edu.hk now return 404.

by_geography.note: share employed in Asia, cohort not stated

rankings_cited.note: school homepage: 'ranked 65th globally by the Financial Times in 2025'. Not found in the FT Global MBA 2026 top 100 as reproduced at https://www.clearadmit.com/mba-rankings/financial-times/ (read 2026-10-13); FT 2026 rank = null.

notes: CUHK MBA site is largely JS-rendered/lead-gated (brochure via cloud.mc.cuhk.edu.hk form). No salary, industry, or class profile figures available from official readable pages: out of salary-based ROI ranking. To re-read via browser: career/employment page and class profile.
